plan.name: ColorfulTodo
plan.description: A colorful, modern web-based Todo application with category organization and visual charts
features: Add, edit, delete, and mark tasks as complete
Filter and view tasks by category
Responsive, modern UI with vibrant color scheme
Dashboard with charts (using Chart.js) showing tasks per category and completion statistics
Drag-and-drop reordering of tasks within categories

files.purpose: Main HTML structure, includes UI layout, category sidebar, task list, and chart canvas
Styling for modern, colorful UI, responsive layout, animations
Application logic: task CRUD, category management, localStorage handling, chart updates
Project overview, setup instructions, and usage guide

implementation_steps.task_description: Create the basic HTML document structure with doctype, html, head and body tags, link the stylesheet styles.css and the script script.js, add a meta viewport tag for responsiveness, and include a title element describing the ColorfulTodo app
Add a header element containing the app title and a search input field, use a single line input with placeholder text for searching tasks, and ensure the header is styled as a flex container
Create a sidebar section with an unordered list for user defined categories, include a button for adding new categories, and assign ids sidebar and categoryList for later JavaScript access
Add a main content area with a section for the task list, include a button for adding new tasks, and create an unordered list element with id taskList where tasks will be rendered
Insert a canvas element with id categoryChart below the task list for displaying Chart.js visualizations, and wrap it in a section with a heading for the dashboard

Add hidden modal dialogs for adding and editing tasks, each containing input fields for task title, description, due date, and a dropdown for selecting a category, and give them ids addTaskModal and editTaskModal for script control
Define root CSS variables for the vibrant color palette, set primary, secondary, accent and background colors, and apply a smooth transition to all elements for animated UI changes
Style the body with a flex layout, set a max width, center the content, and apply the background color variable, ensure the layout adapts to mobile screens using media queries
Create styles for the header including flex alignment, spacing, and a subtle box shadow, style the search input with rounded corners and focus outline using accent color
Style the sidebar with a fixed width, vertical scrolling, background using secondary color, and style the category list items with hover effects and a selected state class

Design the task list items as cards with padding, margin, border radius, background using primary color, and include a checkbox for completion, a drag handle icon, and action buttons for edit and delete
Add responsive grid layout for the main area, ensure the chart canvas scales with the container, and provide animation keyframes for task addition and removal
Define a Task class with constructor accepting id, title, description, dueDate, categoryId, completed flag, and order index, and a Category class with constructor accepting id and name

Implement utility functions loadFromStorage and saveToStorage that read and write JSON strings for tasks and categories using localStorage keys tasksData and categoriesData, and ensure they return empty arrays when no data exists

Create in memory arrays tasks and categories, initialize them by calling loadFromStorage, and expose functions getTasks, getCategories, addTask, updateTask, deleteTask, addCategory, updateCategory, deleteCategory that manipulate the arrays and call saveToStorage after each change

Develop renderCategories function that clears the categoryList element, iterates over categories, creates list item elements with data-id attributes, adds click listeners for filtering, and highlights the currently selected category

Develop renderTaskList function that accepts an optional filterCategoryId, clears the taskList element, sorts tasks by order index, creates list item elements for each task with checkbox, title, due date, drag handle, edit and delete buttons, and attaches event listeners for completion toggle, edit opening, delete action and drag start

Add event listener for the add task button that opens the addTaskModal, populate the category dropdown with current categories, and on form submission create a new Task instance with a generated uuid, push it to tasks via addTask, then re render the task list and update the chart
Add event listener for the edit task modal that fills fields with the selected task data, on submission updates the task via updateTask, re renders the list and chart, and closes the modal

Implement search functionality by adding an input event listener on the search field that filters tasks by title or description containing the query string and calls renderTaskList with the filtered set

Integrate Chart.js by creating a function initChart that selects the categoryChart canvas, defines a bar chart configuration showing tasks per category and completion percentages, and stores the chart instance in a variable chartInstance

Create updateChart function that aggregates tasks by category, calculates completed counts, updates the chartInstance data sets and calls chartInstance.update, and invoke this function after any task or category modification

Implement drag-and-drop reordering by adding dragstart, dragover, drop and dragend listeners on task list items, update the order index of affected tasks in the tasks array, call updateTask for each changed task, persist changes with saveToStorage, and finally re render the list
Add initialization code that calls renderCategories, renderTaskList, initChart, and sets the default filter to show all tasks, ensuring that all UI components are ready when the page loads

Write a project overview describing ColorfulTodo as a modern web based todo app with categories and charts, include a tech stack section listing html css javascript and chartjs, add setup instructions for opening index.html in a browser, and provide usage guide covering adding tasks, managing categories, searching, filtering, drag and drop and interpreting the dashboard charts
